title: Exploring Software Development Tools
description: Essential tools for SREs and platform engineers — Git, jq, yq, terminal IDEs, and productivity tooling that removes friction from infrastructure work.

items.title: Home
items.content_html: Professional guides for SREs and Platform Engineers to master Git, JQ, Tmux, and Neovim. Remove tool friction and focus on building reliable infrastructure.

items.title: FZF Mastery
items.content_html: fzf is a universal interactive filter, not just a history search — the primitive behind picking a pod, a branch, or a file without memorizing exact names.

items.title: Git Workflows
items.content_html: The feature-branch workflow built for IaC — peer review and CI before anything touches production, plus the one extra validation step a YAML merge conflict needs that code doesn't.

items.title: GitHub CLI (gh)
items.content_html: Manage PRs, watch CI, and hit the GitHub API without leaving the shell — gh brings the browser's GitHub workflow to the terminal, scriptable and pipeable into jq.

items.title: Multiple AI CLIs, One tmux Session
items.content_html: Splitting a tmux session across more than one AI CLI, and the specific move of pasting one agent's answer into another and asking what it thinks — treating models as independent reviewers, not one oracle.

items.title: Overview
items.content_html: Professional terminal workflows for platform engineers — persistent sessions, fuzzy navigation, a real Git workflow for infrastructure, and managing GitHub from the shell.

items.title: SSH Mastery
items.content_html: Beyond ssh user@host — the ~/.ssh/config aliases, port forwarding, and ProxyJump tunneling that turn SSH from a login prompt into your primary interface for remote platform work.

items.title: Terminal Multiplexing (tmux)
items.content_html: tmux keeps a session alive on the server even when your connection breaks — sessions, windows, and panes for incident war rooms, connection resilience, and shared troubleshooting.

items.title: jq: Parsing API Responses and Logs
items.content_html: jq is sed, awk, and grep purpose-built for JSON — filtering API responses, Kubernetes manifests, and structured logs during incident response without wrestling raw text.

items.title: Overview
items.content_html: The daily tools that separate a working professional from someone still fighting their environment — Git fundamentals, HTTP debugging, JSON/YAML wrangling, regex, and reading a struggling server.

items.title: Regular Expressions for SREs
items.content_html: The six regex characters that solve 80% of log-searching problems — finding IPs, filtering error codes, and transforming text with grep, sed, and capture groups.

items.title: Terminal Diagnostics
items.content_html: The SRE's vital signs — htop, free, df, iostat, ss, and dmesg, run in order, to turn a vague 'something's slow' into a specific bottleneck before you've been on the box a minute.

items.title: Vim Survival Mode
items.content_html: You're SSH'd into a server with only vi available. Four commands — insert, escape, save, quit — get you in, fixed, and out without needing the rest of Vim's legendary learning curve.

items.title: yq: Wrangling YAML Configs
items.content_html: yq is jq for YAML — auditing Kubernetes manifests for missing resource limits, merging config overlays, and editing indentation-sensitive files without a sed script waiting to break.

items.title: Git Basics
items.content_html: Learn Git fundamentals for platform engineers. Install Git, create your first repository, understand the three states, and start tracking your scripts professionally.

items.title: Git Collaboration
items.content_html: Learn how platform engineers collaborate with Git. Clone repositories, push and pull changes, work with GitHub/GitLab, and sync with your team professionally.

items.title: Seeing API Traffic: curl -v and the Network Tab
items.content_html: Curling an API and reading the JSON back is routine. Now watch what's really on the wire: curl -v and browser DevTools, for headers, status codes, and the full request lifecycle.
